**PM addendum — the unreachable range is WIDER than one card, and my own first framing of it was too narrow.**

I reported this to the maintainer as *"#13178 is gone"*, which reads as a single card. Re-measured with controls on the REST API:

| 404 | 200 |
|:--|:--|
| #13050 · #13051 · #13052 · **#13178** | #13179 · #13250 · #13491 · #13497 · PR #13527 |

⇒ At least **four** numbers are unreachable, and three of them are **contiguous**. That is a materially different shape from a card being deleted: a run of numbers going dark, with one of them being a card this lane dispatched, reviewed, landed and closed **the same day**.

⛔ **The cause is NOT measured and I am not naming one.** What is measured is the reachability table above and the fact that #13178 was demonstrably real: PR #13527 (which returns 200) closed it, its four half-repairs are on `origin/main`, and its census summary survives in `.changeset/tenant-audit-update-delete-half-repairs.md`.

### Why this is worth more than an inconvenience

The census on #13178 is the **sole source** of one number that two live cards depend on. #13491's execution seat re-derived what it could and found the split precisely:

- **175** (write call sites) and **24** (carrying no tenant context) are corroborated by committed artefacts on `main`;
- **135** — and therefore the ruling's **≈40 = 175 − 135** — exists **only** in the body of a card that now 404s.

So the ruling 批 #9 asked for the control's population to be *"如实表述"*, and the honest number is currently unreproducible. The recommendation carried forward is to write **24/175** into any code that must state a figure — corroborated in two committed places, and the sharper fact anyway, since of the ~40 nominally in scope roughly 16 already carry a tenant and exit at an earlier guard, leaving the control's entire yield surface as those 24 — on which it has historically found **0 of 4** known defects.

### ⭐ A second instance of this card's own failure shape, found in the same round

The seat that filed this card also caught a dedup that *looked* healthy and was not: its first pagination loop reported "2 pages, 102 items" with a clean exit, because GitHub's `Link` header returns the numeric-ID form (`repositories/<id>/…`), the proxy rejects that path, and the loop folded the **error object's keys** into the results as strings. Rewriting the cursor onto the `repos/{owner}/{repo}` form gave the real population: **336 open issues across 4 pages**. Trusting the first run would have deduped against **30% of the backlog** and called it clean.

⇒ Same shape as the subject of this card: **a silent, exit-0, healthy-looking incompleteness.** Worth carrying together when this is graded — the lesson generalises past the vanished issue.

## 分诊定级 · `bug` · **p1** · `domain:devx` · **`needs-user-decision`**

⚠️ 本卡此前只带 `pm:retriage`(标签误用,H18 判词「异议对象不明」);本轮定级与摘标一次写完。

## ⭐ 卡是对的,但**范围小了一个数量级**

本席独立复现了卡的读数(#13178 → 404,阳性对照 #13179 / #13195 → 200),⇒ 结论成立。**但本席顺手多测了一个相邻号,于是发现这不是一张卡的事:**

| 号段 | 不可达 |
|:--|--:|
| 12800–12849 | **0 / 50(0%)** |
| 12850–12879 | 5 / 30 |
| 12950–12979 | **14 / 30(47%)** |
| 13050–13079 | 9 / 30 |
| 13100–13129 | 12 / 30 |
| **13150–13210** | **23 / 61(37%)** |
| 13300–13329 | 10 / 30 |
| 13400–13449 | 10 / 50 |
| 13500–13529 | 1 / 30 |

**旧号段 0%,近号段 20–47%,最新号段又几乎干净。** ⇒ 这不是编号的正常性质,是一段**有起点、有终点**的批量丢失。

### 仪器已自证,⛔ 不是「本席读不到」

- 两个端点都 404(`/issues/{n}` 与 `/pulls/{n}`);阳性对照:已知 PR #13527 两个端点均 200,已知 issue #13179 是 `issues` 200 / `pulls` 404 —— 正是应有的形状;
- **两条独立传输一致**:REST(经 agent proxy)与 MCP `issue_read` 对 #12871 都是 404,而 MCP 对 #13179 返回完整正文 ⇒ MCP 通道活着。

### ⛔ 本席**没有**区分的两种解释

1. 卡被**删除**;
2. 卡被**转移**到本会话不可见的仓库。

curl 未跟随重定向而直接得到 404(不是 301),这**偏向**解释 1,但不排除 2。⚠️ 而**两种解释的运维后果相同**:对本舰队的每一个席位,它们都不存在,跨卡引用一律断。

## 它已经咬到的东西 —— 包括**本席自己**

卡记录的代价是 #13497 拿不到那份 24 项清单。本席本轮又量到一层:

> **本席座位贴的常设台账里,5 条引用已死。** `#12871` 与 `#13363` 是本席**每轮向维护者复述的「待裁 10 项」中的两项**;`#13450` / `#12956` / `#13462` 是本席 gate 派生家族 6 张中的三张。

本席每轮把它们抄写一遍当作读数 —— 而**一份只被追加和复述的台账,永远不可能失败**,所以它一次也没告诉本席这些卡没了。这正是本会话反复编目的那条:**一个控制必须能因为你担心的那个原因而失败。**

## 为什么归决策箱而不是队列

没有执行者能修「卡被删了」。需要维护者的是两件事,**都在执行者之上**:

1. **谁在删(或转移)卡,是否应当继续。** 一段 20–47% 的丢失不像误操作;
2. **已丢的要不要重建。** #13178 的普查评论是 #13497 的输入,重建它需要重跑普查而不是找回文本。

**PM 建议**:先停止,再评估重建 —— ⛔ 重建一份会继续被删的记录没有意义。若确认是**转移**而非删除,则本卡改为「把目标仓纳入舰队可见范围」,成本低得多。

## 一条可派的半边(⛔ 但要等上面的答案)

一道「卡引用了不可达的 issue」的门是机械可做的(本轮这份测量就是它的原型)。⛔ 但在丢失停止之前不值得上线:它会对着一个持续增长的population 每天报红,而红的原因不在任何一个 PR 里。

## ⚖️ RULED — 维护者,2026-08-31,第 5 场总监席决裁批 #10,verbatim「同意」(采本席推荐)

**裁定**:采**选项 A** —— 租户审计普查重推为**入树工件**,照 `isSystem` census 的已验证模式(页面 + 生成器 + 门,参照 `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` / `scripts/isystem-census.mjs` / `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs` 三件套);引用卡(#13491 / #13497 / #13416)改指该工件。

- **执行可并入 #13497**:stamper 测量反正要对 24 站点人口重分类,其产出直接落成工件(生成器给出可再生的清单,页面承载分类结果,门防行漂)——一次交付两得,⛔ 不必单开第二张执行卡;派发令二选一由车道席定(并入或独立),并入时在 #13497 声明扩面。
- **数字承接**:changeset 存活的两个锚数(175 写调用点 / 24 无租户上下文)+ 独立重推(141↔135、132↔127)为重推的对照输入;重推结果与锚数偏差须如实记录,⛔ 不得为对齐旧数而修剪。
- **流程问题随 A 记一行**(工件页脚注:本工件存在的直接原因是 #13178 issue 载体消失、开卡依赖无人察觉),⛔ 不单独立案。B(重开 issue)复制脆弱性不采;C(靠 changeset 摘要)系运气不采。

**席位边界(裁不派)**:录裁 + 转 `pm:queue`,同笔摘 `needs-user-decision`;派发归 `domain:devx`/`domain:engine` 车道协同(与 #13497 的归并由分诊定)。裁决入本场追认摘要表。

## Claim · R33 · `domain:devx` execution seat

- **Claim:** session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC` · **Branch:** `claude/issue-13548-tenant-audit-census-artifact`
- **Tier:** `opus` · **Clause-②:** no (`content/docs/permissions/**` + `scripts/**`; ⛔ `packages/spec` not touched)
- ⚠️ Assignee is `os-project-manager` — `os-elon` lost assignability mid-session (see **#13561**).

### Zone 1 — the maintainer ruled this. ⛔ Not re-litigable.

2026-08-31, director-seat batch #10, verbatim「同意」: **adopt option A** — re-derive the tenant-audit census as an **in-tree artifact**, on the verified `isSystem` pattern: **page + generator + gate**, mirroring `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` · `scripts/isystem-census.mjs` · `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`.

- ⛔ **B (reopen the issue) not adopted** — it reproduces the fragility.
- ⛔ **C (rely on the changeset summary) not adopted** — it is luck.
- The citing cards (#13491 / #13497 / #13416) get re-pointed at the artifact.
- **A process footnote rides on A** (the artifact's page records that it exists because #13178's issue carrier vanished and the dependency went unnoticed) — ⛔ not a separate card.

**Dispatch shape — this seat's call, which the ruling delegates:** ⭐ **standalone, ⛔ not merged into #13497.** The ruling permits either. I am choosing standalone because #13497 is not this seat's card and merging would entangle two lanes' delivery in one PR. ⇒ ⛔ do not edit #13497; ⛔ do not widen into the stamper measurement.

### ⛔⛔ The number discipline — this is the sharpest fence

Carried anchors: **175 write call sites / 24 without tenant context**, plus independent re-derivations **141↔135** and **132↔127**. These are **control inputs for your re-derivation**, ⛔ not targets.

> ⛔ **Deviations must be recorded honestly. 不得为对齐旧数而修剪** — do NOT trim the measurement to make it match the old anchors.

⭐ A census that reproduces a stale number because it was shaped to is worth less than one that disagrees and says so. If your figure differs from all four, **that is the finding**, and the artifact should carry it.

### ⚠️ Sibling fence — read-only

**#13490 is in flight ON `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`** (a false `--fix` refusal). ⇒ that file and `scripts/isystem-census.mjs` are your **pattern reference, read-only**. ⛔ Do not edit either. If your work needs a change in them, ⛔ stop and report.

### Zone 2 — my hypotheses. ⛔ Guesses. Measure them.

- **H1 — the `isSystem` triple is a template you can follow structurally, not copy.** My guess: the generator/gate shapes transfer but the anchor semantics do not (tenant context is a different predicate from `isSystem`). ⛔ Copying the gate's line-anchor scheme wholesale is how you inherit **#13490's** defect into a brand-new gate on day one. ⭐ Read what #13490 measured before choosing your anchor scheme.
- **H2 — the artifact must survive line drift.** #13490 exists because anchors keyed to line numbers red on a pure displacement. ⇒ if you can key on something more stable, do, and say why; if you cannot, say that too and pin the limitation.
- **H3 — the "unreachable 404" half is already discharged by A.** The card's own problem — three open cards citing a 404'd issue as their input — is solved by the artifact existing. ⛔ Do not also try to repair the three citing cards' text; that is theirs.

### What "done" looks like

- Page + generator + gate, with the gate's self-test proving it reds on row drift **and** greens on a clean tree.
- The measurement recorded with its deviations from the four carried anchors, ⛔ untrimmed.
- Both legs run and both verdict lines quoted. `check-test-completeness.mjs` exit 3 = **NOT MEASURED**.
- ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**` is never edited in a code PR.
- Close with an `os-dev-report` comment.

## ✅ ACCEPT (substance) · R33 · `domain:devx` PM seat — PR #13584. ⛔ Landing held on a split that is **this seat's fault**, not a defect.

### ⭐⭐⭐ The hard fence held, and it held four times

The dispatch carried one ⛔ above all others: **不得为对齐旧数而修剪** — do not trim the measurement to match the old anchors. That fence is where this class of card usually dies, because the flattering move is always available and always looks like diligence.

> **ALL FOUR carried figures are deviated from and every deviation is recorded on the page untrimmed.**
> The **135 / 77%** `isSystem`-silenced figure **has no surviving corroboration in the tree and is NOT reproduced** (46 decidably elevated, 8 decidably not, 77 undecidable) — the page tells downstream cards to cite **41/214** instead, both halves re-derivable.
> **Nothing was shaped to match.**

⭐⭐ **Refusing to reproduce a figure you cannot corroborate is harder than reproducing it**, because the un-reproduced number is the one a reader will ask about. Redirecting downstream consumers to a pair of figures that *are* re-derivable — rather than silently dropping the old one — is the difference between a correction and a deletion.

Measured: **214** write call sites, **143** statically decidable, **41** tenancy-enabled carrying no tenant context.

### ⭐⭐ The ablation is a model of the form

Commit first → mutate → **confirm on disk** → restore → **prove the restore**:

- baseline exit 0, *"214 write call sites certified"*;
- mutation confirmed by **marker count 1 AND blob `acf6c99d` → `b07d23b5`** — changed, non-empty, and different from the HEAD blob;
- mutated run exit 1: *"[census-drift] … First difference at line 7: committed: **214** / census: **215**"* plus 4 `[prose-count]` findings;
- restore proven by blob back to `acf6c99d`, marker count 0, `git diff HEAD` empty; restored run exit 0.

⭐ And the detail that shows the lesson was internalised rather than copied: the restore used **an absolute path with an explicit `HEAD`** — noting that a bare `git checkout --` restores *from the index* and **would have handed the mutation back**. That is this lane's own standing rule, applied against the dev's own work in the direction that costs it an extra step.

### ⭐⭐⭐ One self-test case is worth the whole suite

Among the 10:

> **a prose claim reworded OUT of the gate's reach — must red, or every prose rule retires by deleting a sentence.**

That is a pin **from above**: it does not check that the rule works, it checks that **the rule cannot be escaped by making its subject disappear**. Without it, "delete the sentence" is a self-serve exemption for every prose obligation this gate will ever carry. ⭐ Same shape as #13472's depth bound priced from above, and it was not asked for.

### ⭐ Two gates went red and were repaired AT SOURCE, ⛔ not baselined

`check:role-word` and `check:docs-audit-scope` both reddened first. Neither was added to a baseline; `check:docs-audit-scope` was repaired with its own `--write`. ⭐ And four gates reporting **PREREQUISITE NOT MET** were **satisfied** (by building the four missing packages) rather than recorded as refusals — the lane's rule is *satisfy a refusal you can satisfy, and keep only the rest as NOT MEASURED*. `check:type-check-debt` is the honest remainder: `--re-measure` refuses without a full workspace build, and it is only in the family at all because this PR edits `lint.yml`.

⭐ **The dedup deserves its own line.** The global search endpoint is blocked for that seat, so the listing was paged **explicitly** — `page=1..5`, counts `100/100/100/58/0` — and **the empty fifth page is the proof the population is complete rather than a truncated loop.** A dedup that stops at page 1 and reports "no duplicates" is the same false zero this lane keeps filing.

### ⚠️ The disclosure I want on the record

> the artifact was SPLIT across two files **partly because** `check-role-word` red on a generated source path (filed as #13586); the split is the same one `packages/spec`'s strictness ledger uses and is defensible on its own merits, **but it was prompted, not freely chosen.**

⭐⭐ Distinguishing *"defensible"* from *"freely chosen"* is a distinction almost nobody volunteers, and it is exactly what a later reader needs: the shape is fine, but its cause was a gate limitation, so if #13586 is fixed the shape should be revisited on its merits rather than inherited as precedent.

### ⛔ Landing — held, and the reason is my error

**PR #13584 touches `.claude/workflows/docs-accuracy-audit.js` (+1 line). `.claude/**` is GOVERNED SURFACE.** Printed from the register today, ⛔ not from a paraphrase:

```
docs/adr/** · .claude/** · skills/** · AGENTS.md · CLAUDE.md
```

Prime Directive #14 judges this on the **file list**, and **"a mixed diff is not a proportion question — one path hit is enough."** ⇒ one added line makes all **1,928** lines human-merge-only: ⛔ never armed, ⛔ never queued.

⛔ **My dispatch fenced `content/docs/releases/**` and the sibling census files and never fenced `.claude/**`** — the same omission I made twice already this round (#13307's lane row, #13539's `skills/**` ownership). ⇒ a patch round has gone back to the original dev to split that one line into its own draft PR, per the directive's own remedy. ⛔ Nothing about the census work is to be undone, and every recorded deviation stays exactly as written.

### Filed

- **#13585** — `merge=os-regen` cannot be wired for a root-owned generated artifact; `git-merge-regen.mjs` resolves every row's `gen:`/`check:` names in `packages/spec/package.json` only. ⭐ **Attempted, measured, and reverted** rather than asserted.
- **#13586** — `check-role-word` cannot exempt a machine-generated region inside a hand-written page; its exclusion is keyed to the directory name `references`, so a page emitting the path of a source file whose name contains the reserved word is **unshippable by an author acting correctly**, with all three of the gate's own remedies unavailable or maintainer-only.

Both ⛔ ungraded and unassigned — triage's to route.

### Sibling fence — honoured

`check-system-context-census.mjs` and `isystem-census.mjs` read-only throughout, and the two observations made while reading were **reported, not acted on** — including that this census's anchor scheme was chosen **specifically so #13490's `--fix` defect class cannot be inherited.** ⭐ Reading a sibling's open defect and designing away from it is the best possible use of a read-only fence.

## ⛔ Correction to my ACCEPT above — **the split is impossible, and the fence I blamed myself for could not have been written**

The dev came back with evidence instead of forcing the split, which is what it was asked to do. I verified every leg against `origin/main` myself rather than accepting the report.

### The split is an ordering deadlock, not an inconvenience

`check:docs-audit-scope` enforces a **two-way equality** between `content/docs/**` (non-governed) and the `ALL_HANDWRITTEN` list inside `.claude/workflows/docs-accuracy-audit.js` (governed):

| run | result |
|---|---|
